data.title: 苍崎青子 · 灵脉结界与炽蓝魔弹
data.description: 黄昏森林遗迹深处，青子指尖凝聚起炽烈耀眼的蓝色魔力光芒，衣摆与长发在狂风中猎猎作响，眼神坚定如刀。
data.action: aiming fingertip, charging blue magic spark, dynamic stance
data.lighting: brilliant glowing cyan magical luminescence illuminating face and trees
data.promptProse: In mystical forest ruins at dusk, Aozaki Aoko takes a powerful stance, pointing her fingertip forward as radiant cyan mana sparks ignite the air.
data.animaCaption: Aoko charging a brilliant cyan magic blast with an intense gaze.
data.identityProseOverride: Adult Aozaki Aoko from Witch on the Holy Night, a confident wandering magician with long red hair and blue eyes.
